_read_me: Early access sign-ups (src/sections/900-early). Fill ONE and rebuild; the site switches to early access on its own. api: the waitlist worker's URL (worker/, https://studio-waitlist.<you>.workers.dev): places, referrals, Brevo. brevo_form: a Brevo form's action URL (no places). webhook: any URL that takes a JSON POST. All empty: the live site stays on Download for Mac; localhost and ?early still show the flow.
_signup_open: The public sign-up switch (lead + Evan's go). true: the site's Download buttons say Get Studio and go to askstudio.ai/start/ (the free sign-up: sign in, the questions, the download), and /start/ stops sending visitors to early access. The waitlist stays at /early-access/ and on the pricing band. On this Mac, ?open previews it switched on.
_count_offset: People who already asked for Studio but are not in the Worker yet (Custom Esignature users). Added to the live count and to every place shown. Set to 0 once they are imported.
